g.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: 99% of all the code work has been made by AI under human supervision.

g.text: A large majority of project planning, testing and design ideas have been made by me with my own ideas
and with inspiration from other people's works. All of those people have been credited under the credits
section. Due to the obvious AI involvement it is important for me to acknowledge the obvious technical
debt as a result of this and this is why every ai made file or library or whatever is free for anyone to use
under all circumstances and for whatever project or purpose they might feel fit.
